LESSON: KALPASUTRA AND DHAMMAPADA

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Scriptures
Topic 4.1: Kalpasutra and Dhammapada

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Kalpasutra and Dhammapada. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why are scriptures important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. acknowledge Kalpasutra and (4 lessons) divine knowledge
2. appreciate the importance of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada as holy Scriptures. 4.2Introduction to Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji (4 lessons) installation of Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji as the Living Guru. 4.3 Handling of Scriptures (3 Lessons) scriptures for strengthening faith. 94

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. acknowledge Kalpasutra and (4 lessons) divine knowledge
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to acknowledge Kalpasutra and (4 lessons) divine knowledge. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the importance of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada as holy Scriptures. 4.2Introduction to Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji (4 lessons) installation of Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji as the Living Guru. 4.3 Handling of Scriptures (3 Lessons) scriptures for strengthening faith. 94
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada as holy Scriptures. 4.2Introduction to Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji (4 lessons) installation of Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji as the Living Guru. 4.3 Handling of Scriptures (3 Lessons) scriptures for strengthening faith. 94. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Kalpasutra and Dhammapada.
2. Explain Kalpasutra and Dhammapada to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kalpasutra and Dhammapada.
4. Show that you can: acknowledge Kalpasutra and (4 lessons) divine knowledge
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Kalpasutra and Dhammapada. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why are scriptures important?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. acknowledge Kalpasutra and (4 lessons) divine knowledge
2. appreciate the importance of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada as holy Scriptures. 4.2Introduction to Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji (4 lessons) installation of Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji as the Living Guru. 4.3 Handling of Scriptures (3 Lessons) scriptures for strengthening faith. 94

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
